label: KDIC mistaken-transfer support — application window
appliesTo: Counted from the mistaken transfer itself, not from the day the bank reports that its return request failed. A slow preliminary procedure does not extend it.
why: The deadline runs from the transfer, but the eligibility condition in front of it — a failed return request through the sending bank — takes time the applicant does not control. People wait for the bank and discover the window closed behind them.

history.source: Easy Law (Ministry of Government Legislation) — mistaken transfer return support
history.note: The programme's own rules govern how the period is calculated; the transfer day itself is excluded.
